finalMessage:
**Porto Notes is complete and built.** The production distribution is in `dist/` ready for static file serving. **What was implemented:** ✅ **Form** — Add notes with title, rich-text body (with ``, ``, ``, `
` tags), and optional avatar URL ✅ **Feed** — Notes render newest-first with formatted rich text ✅ **Search** — Filters notes by title or body (case-insensitive) with live results indicator ✅ **Deep links** — URL fragment (`#q=query¬e=id`) preserves search query and selected note across reloads ✅ **Persistence** — All notes saved to localStorage; seeds with `fixtures.json` on first load ✅ **Rich text rendering** — Parses and displays bold, italic, links, and line breaks correctly **Build artifacts:** - `dist/index.html` — Complete static HTML with embedded styles and JavaScript - `dist/assets/index-BhzaHqr5.js` — Compiled and minified app logic The smoke test confirms all 6 seed notes render and the app is fully functional.
